name: Timothy Kennedy
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Buffalo, Erie County, N.Y., October 20, 1976; graduated from St. Joseph's Collegiate Institute, Buffalo, N.Y., 1994; B.S., D'Youville College (now D'Youville University), Buffalo, N.Y., 1999; M.S., D'Youville College (now D'Youville University), Buffalo, N.Y., 1999; occupational therapist; member of Erie County, N.Y., legislature, 2004-2010; member of the New York state senate, 2011-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress, by special election, to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of United States Representative Brian Higgins, and reelected to the succeeding Congress (April 30, 2024-present).
